errors.evidence: The chart contains four data lines, but the description states there are only three. It completely omits the light blue line, which represents the category 'zugewandert bis 2009'.
The tick labels on the horizontal x-axis are shown in 10-year intervals (20, 30, 40, etc.), not one-year intervals.
The description of the y-axis does not mention that the tick labels are at intervals of 20 percentage points.

errors.text_span: sinkt dann bis 75% im Alter von 60 Jahren und erreicht schließlich einen Wert von 17% im Alter von 70 Jahren
errors.evidence: The description provides incorrect values for the black line. At age 60, the value is approximately 80%, not 75%. At age 70, the value is approximately 5%, not 17%.

errors.text_span: Die hellgraue Linie beginnt bei 68% im Alter von 20 Jahren, steigt bis 85% im Alter von 37 Jahren an, sinkt bis 78% im Alter von 60 Jahren und erreicht einen Wert von 24% im Alter von 70 Jahren.
errors.evidence: All numerical values reported for the grey line ('hellgraue Linie', category 'in Deutschland geboren') are incorrect. It starts at approx. 52% (not 68%), has a local peak at approx. 78% (not 85%), is at approx. 70% at age 60 (not 78%), and ends at approx. 10% (not 24%).

errors.text_span: Die blaue Linie beginnt bei 44% im Alter von 20 Jahren und steigt bis 72% im Alter von 46 Jahren an
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states the starting point and a peak for the blue line. The line starts at age 21 with a value of approximately 38%, not at age 20 with 44%. The value at age 46 is approximately 50%, not a peak of 72%.
The description of the legend is incomplete; it omits the entry for 'zugewandert bis 2009', which corresponds to the missing light blue line.
